dog.description_text:
Meet Badger!

Badger is a 2-year-old goofy guy with a whole lot of wiggles. He’s friendly, affectionate, and always ready to make new friends. He will lean his whole body in toward you for snuggles and petting.

Whether he’s chasing a toy, playing a game, or showing off his silly side, Badger brings plenty of fun wherever he goes. Badger also knows how to settle down and enjoy some quality downtime with his people. He’s the kind of dog who can keep you smiling during playtime and then happily relax by your side when the day winds down.

Interested in meeting Badger? Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more about him!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
